narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green: 625 total, 625 passing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only 3 of 625 cases caught it, all with nonzero discount and tax.

Changed it to tax the discounted total directly. Nothing else to do.
